## Pricing & Package Tiers
All event coverage is categorized into 3 transparent tiers: Silver, Gold, and Diamond.
- Signature Diamond Wedding Cinema (2 Days Full Coverage): ₹91,000
  Inclusions: 5-Member Senior Crew (Cinematographer, Candid Photographer, Traditional Videographer, Traditional Photographer, Aerial Drone Videographer), 1 Premium Master Leather Album, 1 Cinematic Highlight Film, 1 Full-Length Wedding Feature Film, 3 Trending Instagram 4K Reels, 1 Luxury Photo Wall Frame, and complete Master RAW & High-Res Data.
- Maternity Shoot Special: ₹6,500
  Inclusions: 2 Hours dedicated creative studio/outdoor session, includes creative props, 1 luxury designer gown/dress, and full color-corrected edited master images.
- Outstation Travel Policy: Outstation travel and stay accommodation are provided or reimbursed by the client. Package prices strictly exclude travel expenses.
- Payment Schedule: 40% non-refundable advance booking retainer to lock calendar dates, 40% on the morning of the event shoot, and 20% balance settled prior to album printing dispatch and master drive handover.
